q: Replace every mark below 40 with 40, leaving the rest as they are.
code:
import numpy as np
marks = np.array([72, 35, 64, 28, 91])
print(np.where(marks < 40, 40, marks))

q: Sort an array of salaries, and also print the names in order of salary.
code:
import numpy as np
names = np.array(["Rahul", "Priya", "Amit", "Kavya"])
sal   = np.array([47764, 62990, 51200, 45100])
order = np.argsort(sal)
print("sorted salaries:", np.sort(sal))
print("names in order :", names[order])

q: Sort a 3 by 4 array along each row, then along each column.
code:

a = np.array([[9, 2, 7, 4],
              [5, 8, 1, 6],
              [3, 0, 2, 9]])
print("along each row:")
print(np.sort(a, axis=1))
print("along each column:")
print(np.sort(a, axis=0))

q: Stack two arrays on top of each other, then side by side.
code:
import numpy as np
a = np.array([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
b = np.array([[5, 6], [7, 8]])
print("stacked vertically:")
print(np.vstack([a, b]))
print("stacked horizontally:")
print(np.hstack([a, b]))
